blueprint.label: [item=thruster]Surfer
blueprint.description:
A nearly perfect starter ship.
Set your request in the constant combinator near the engine.
For auto pilot, research physical projectile damage and shooting speed lv5, or add more turrets.
For Fulgora, add 4 solar panels.
For Gleba, add 2 solar panels,  set the minimum rocket capacity of agri sci to 400 or anything you like, and set the wait condition sci>0. With more firepower and advanced asteroid processing, engines can be added.
--blueprint by internet pantheon 可爱猫娘
